title: Slop New York
tagline: Manhattan on foot, by car, by bike, or by helicopter
description: A browser simulation of Manhattan built with three.js WebGPURenderer and TSL. Explore surveyed building footprints, street trees, subway entrances, traffic, and pedestrians on foot, by car, by bicycle, or by helicopter, with multiple cameras and times of day.
features: Manhattan streets, building footprints, heights, and street trees from NYC open data
Walking, driving, cycling, and helicopter modes
Street traffic, buses, pedestrians, signals, and subway entrances
Chase, action, first-person, and landmark cameras
Selectable times of day, full map, minimap, and synthesized city audio

lineage.note: The public source preserves implementation history from 2026-10-20 but no neutral seed digest, runner isolation record, or accepted parent. Independence cannot be established.

tools: three.js WebGPURenderer and TSL (observed in deployment)

prompt.note: The public source and commit history name no model, harness, prompt, or agent transcript.

licenses.assetStatement: The pinned source is MIT licensed. Its README credits NYC Open Data, MTA subway entrance data, and OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) for geographic data. three.js and web fonts load from public CDNs. Complete per-asset license clearance is not established.

controls: WASD or arrow keys to move, drive, pedal, or fly
Space to jump; Space or E to ascend and Q or C to descend in the helicopter
1–4 to walk, drive, cycle, or fly
V or 5–0 to change camera; mouse drag to orbit
B for horn, N for sound, H to hide the HUD, and M for the map
Touch and gamepad controls are claimed by the deployment
limitations: Showcase only: no benchmark handoff, model, prompt, harness, agent counts, or isolation evidence is published.
The city is New York, not San Francisco.
The source is unbundled static files with no package manifest, pnpm lockfile, or build:mirage command.
The deployment loads three.js and fonts from jsDelivr and Google Fonts at runtime.
The recorded build date is the deployed commit 13dd142b480bcfa01a6b18e36127c87e41cb4d80 on 2026-10-28; the source history began on 2026-10-20.
The deployment is actively updated; the live game may differ from the pinned commit.
The cover is an unaltered Mirage browser capture of the public deployment. Touch and gamepad support were not verified.
